text:
claire: heads-up — ran into two related SDK vs REST parity surprises while wiring the onboarding 'list users' flow in sample-apps/onboard. Both caused flaky pagination and token churn.

oscar: quick summary?

claire: repro in Node SDK v1.3.0: the SDK URL-encodes the continuation cursor and also silently clamps pageSize to 20. REST accepts base64 cursor and page_size up to 100. This makes our sample app show incomplete lists and then repeatedly call token refresh because the list loop interprets missing cursor as auth failure.

claire: snippet:
```js
// node SDK v1.3.0
const res = await client.users.list({ pageSize: 50, cursor: 'eyJpZCI6IjEwIn0=' })
// -> res.items.length === 20, res.next_cursor === undefined or incorrect
```

claire: proxied GETs show SDK turned query into `?pageSize=20&cursor=eyJpZCI6IjEwIn0%253D` (note the %25 double-encoding) whereas our curl test uses `?page_size=50&cursor=eyJpZCI6IjEwIn0=` and server returns next_cursor and more items.

ben: double-encoding is a classic generator/serializer mismatch. Also pageSize vs page_size renaming could be clipping. Which generator flags did we use for query param formatting?

claire: client was generated with `convert_params=true` so camelCase -> snake_case mapping happened for page_size but the codepath that builds the query string uses a different encoder. Looks like the cursor param is being encoded twice (toURI then encodeURIComponent).

irene: side-effect: our token refresh logic treats a missing next_cursor as an error in the iterator, and the list helper kicks off a refresh. With flaky network it can cause two concurrent refresh calls and then both the SDK wrapper and the infra layer retry, producing a token-churn loop.

oscar: can you paste the stack trace for the refresh loop?

claire: stacktrace (abbreviated):
```
Error: 401 Unauthorized
    at Client._request (/src/sdk/dist/request.js:234:21)
    at Users.list (/src/sdk/dist/users.js:48:18)
    at processList (/sample-apps/onboard/index.js:72:12)
    at async main (/sample-apps/onboard/index.js:90:5)
Caused by: token refresh attempt failed: refresh denied (401)
```

ben: ok action items: 1) fix query param encoder so we don't double-encode cursor; 2) ensure generator emits correct query names (page_size) and allows page_size up to 100; 3) centralize token refresh so concurrent requests await the same refresh promise (single-flight).

irene: also add a parity e2e in CI that: posts a list request via raw curl and via SDK and diffs querystring + received server JSON (cursor + item counts). This will catch regressions.

oscar: good. I'll take the encoder fix and add unit tests for cursor handling. ben, can you own regen and page_size limits?

ben: yep, will regen with convert_params=false for query params and add an explicit mapping layer to avoid accidental renames. Also will ensure page_size max is 100 in SDK validation.

ci-bot: Created issue redwood/sdk-node#920: "node SDK: double-encodes continuation cursor; clamps pageSize to 20; token refresh race in list iterator" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/920 :robot_face:

claire: for immediate unblock I'll switch the onboarding sample to call REST for list endpoints (simple fetch) and paste the curl-based loop. Not ideal but unblocks QA. I'll open a tiny PR to sample-apps/onboard with the swap and link the issue.

ioscar: thanks Claire. Let's also add a note in the SDK changelog explaining the page_size change so customers don't get surprised.

irene: one more test idea: simulate expired token mid-iterator and assert we only run one refresh and resume cleanly (no duplicate downstream calls). We'll add that to the parity suite.

claire: thanks all. assigning P1 to the encoder + refresh fixes. Will post PR links when ready.
